sentences.en: The present is the only reality and the only certainty.
sentences.zh: 1. 现在是唯一的现实和唯一的确切性。

sentences.en: I can say with certainty that he hates me.
sentences.zh: 2. 我可以肯定地说他恨我。

sentences.en: The public...demands certainties...But there are no certainties.
sentences.zh: 3. 公众...要求确切的答案...但没有确切的答案。

senses.zh: 确定性，确实性；必然发生的事，确定的事物
